payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the novel aspects of the document-level encoder introduced in the paper, including its architecture and application in summarization tasks.

claims.text: The novel document-level encoder is based on BERT and is designed to express the semantics of a document while obtaining representations for its sentences.
The encoder is integrated into both extractive and abstractive summarization models, utilizing inter-sentence Transformer layers to capture document-level features.
A new fine-tuning schedule is proposed that uses different optimizers for the encoder and decoder to address the mismatch between pretrained and randomly-initialized components.
